plans.name: Go
plans.note: Each window is shared by every model, each weighing by its own budget: 20%, 50% and 100% of its published monthly limit for the 5-hour, weekly and monthly windows. The window's own budget is the plan's most common monthly limit, at the same share. The page does not say whether the windows slide or reset on a schedule, and "monthly" is approximated as 720 hours. A model listed with no budget is free for a limited time.
